items.title: Basketball LEGEND Nikos Galis SURPRISES Giannis, Kostas & Alex Antetokounmpo LIVE in Athens, Greece
items.author: Thanalysis Show
items.body_excerpt: SPEECHLESS! Thanasis Antetokounmpo hosted his brothers Giannis, Kostas and Alex for a Thanalysis Live, in Athens, Greece. As part of the epic live show, Thanasis brought in basketball LEGEND Nikos Galis to surprise his brothers. This live on-stage show was recorded in the summer…
